title: helictochloa gervaisii subsp. arundana
intro: Helictochloa gervaisii subsp. arundana, commonly known as Italian rye-grass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Italian rye-grass include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities.
